answer: Jury seats are drawn like marbles from a jar, but a key gets one marble per 100 POA it has locked for 20 epochs, not one per key. Splitting stake across many sybil keys buys no extra marbles, and fresh keys get none. Locked stake sits in a lagoon pool and cannot move while its seats are open. Keys that keep voting against final verdicts drop out of the jade tier, which grants bonus seats, and then lose 10% of the lock per miss. A farm must lock as much capital as an honest grader and risks it on every bad vote.
